nodes.name: Open the dashboard
nodes.notes: Served by n8n rather than Netlify on purpose — see the README. n8n holds every credential already, so the page is built server-side and the browser never sees a secret.

nodes.name: Upcoming bookings
nodes.notes: Two hours back rather than from now, so a session already under way is still on screen while you are in it.

nodes.name: Awaiting payment
nodes.notes: Raised but unpaid. This is the gap nothing could see before: somebody booked, took the slot, and never paid.

nodes.name: Stripe balance
nodes.notes: Available is what you can spend; pending is money taken that Stripe has not settled yet. Different numbers, and the difference matters at month end.

nodes.name: Serve it
nodes.notes: no-store: this page shows money and customer names and should not sit in a browser cache.
